properties.name: Seitah (crater floor, olivine-rich igneous cumulate)
properties.description: Olivine-rich igneous cumulate rocks of the crater floor, distinct from delta/lake sediments
properties.caveat: Approximate position from NASA context imagery (https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/flight-12-view-of-south-seitah/); Liu et al. (2022) identify Seitah as an olivine-rich igneous cumulate crater-floor unit, separate from the delta/lake deposits. Verify position against the Perseverance traverse map.
properties.science_goal: Olivine-rich igneous cumulate rocks of the crater floor, distinct from delta/lake sediments

properties.name: Pahrump Hills (base of Mount Sharp)
properties.description: Murray formation mudstones at the base of Mount Sharp (ancient lake deposits)
properties.caveat: Sol-753 rover end-of-drive position at Pahrump Hills arrival, rounded to four decimals from NASA MSL waypoints; a rover position, not the full outcrop extent. Not for navigation. The point lies about 0.19 km outside the generalized Bagnold Dunes envelope, but the centre of its ~460 m score cell lies just inside it, so the cell carries the dune penalty (score x0.70). This comes from grid resolution and the 200-500 m outline uncertainty; it does not mean the outcrop is dune-covered.
properties.science_goal: Murray formation mudstones at the base of Mount Sharp (ancient lake deposits)
